detailModal.balanceNote: The Balance is the actual cash movement for the month. To see what is left after covering the Budget, open the Result.

detailModal.resultNote: The Result deducts every outflow of the month — including those that paid bills, taxes and cost centers — plus what is still left to pay from the Budget. Each payment leaves the cash and reduces the Budget still to pay at the same time, so nothing is counted twice. Extra inflows add up as surplus.
